errors.evidence: The description identifies the chart on the right as a "vertical bar chart" but fails to mention that it is a stacked bar chart, which is a crucial structural detail explaining how the components of renewable energy are represented.

errors.text_span: Цветовете на секторите в кръговата диаграма са съответни на тези в легендата, която се намира в долната част на фигура.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the pie chart's colors correspond to the legend at the bottom of the figure. The pie chart has no legend; its sectors are labeled directly. The legend belongs to the stacked bar chart on the right.

errors.text_span: Осите на стълбовата диаграма са вертикални
errors.evidence: The description states that the "axes" (plural) of the bar chart are vertical. The chart has only one vertical axis (the Y-axis). The categorical axis is horizontal.
